title: Taco Alley Complaint Resolution Policy, version 2026.09 (synthetic, for course demonstrations)
definitions: "Order total" is the total field on the order record (subtotal + tax + delivery fee).
"Item price" is quantity multiplied by unit price for that line on the order record.
"Late" is measured from the promised_delivery_time to the actual_delivery_time on the order record.
"Monetary resolution" means store_credit, partial_refund, or full_refund with a refund_amount greater than 0.
"Recent resolutions" are entries in the prior resolutions list dated within the 90 days before the complaint date.

rules.title: Missing items
rules.text: Missing items. If the customer reports an item as missing and the item appears on the order record, propose partial_refund equal to the item price of the missing quantity. If every item on the order is missing, treat the complaint as order_not_received (R4). If the item the customer names does not appear on the order record, propose no_action, cite R1, and explain that the item was not part of the order.

rules.title: Wrong item
rules.text: Wrong item. If the customer received a different item than ordered, propose either replacement (refund_amount 0) or partial_refund equal to the item price of the item that was wrong. Cite R2.

rules.title: Late delivery
rules.text: Late delivery. Less than 15 minutes late: apology_only. 15 to 30 minutes late: store_credit of 5.00. More than 30 minutes late: store_credit of 20 percent of the order total, rounded to the nearest cent, with a maximum of 15.00. Cite R3.

rules.title: Order not received
rules.text: Order not received. If the customer never received the order, propose full_refund of the order total. Cite R4.

rules.title: Wrong address
rules.text: Wrong address. If the courier delivered to the wrong address and the customer did not receive the order, propose full_refund of the order total and cite R5. If the customer eventually recovered the order, treat it as a late delivery under R3 instead.

rules.title: Food quality
rules.text: Food quality. For cold, stale, incorrectly prepared, or otherwise poor-quality food with no safety concern, propose either replacement (refund_amount 0) or partial_refund equal to the item price of the affected items. Cite R6.

rules.title: Food safety
rules.text: Food safety. For foreign objects, undercooked meat, allergen exposure, reported illness, or unsafe food handling, propose escalate_to_manager with refund_amount 0 and requires_human_approval true. Do not propose a refund amount; the manager decides. Cite R7.

rules.title: Cleanliness and staff conduct
rules.text: Cleanliness and staff conduct. For complaints about the dining area, restrooms, wait times, or employee behavior that do not involve an order defect, propose apology_only with refund_amount 0 and log the complaint for the store manager. Cite R8.

rules.title: Approval threshold
rules.text: Approval threshold. Any monetary resolution greater than 25.00 requires requires_human_approval true. Cite R9 in addition to the rule that set the amount.

rules.title: Repeat resolutions
rules.text: Repeat resolutions. If the customer has 2 or more recent resolutions, any monetary resolution requires requires_human_approval true. The customer remains eligible for the resolution. Cite R10 in addition to the rule that set the amount.

rules.title: Limits
rules.text: Limits. refund_amount may never exceed the order total. affected_items must be item names copied exactly from the order record. Refunds go to the original payment method; store credit is used only where a rule specifies it.

rules.title: Filing window
rules.text: Filing window. If the complaint date is more than 14 days after the order date, an order-defect complaint (R1 to R6) is not eligible for a monetary resolution or replacement. Propose apology_only with refund_amount 0 and cite R12. Complaints under R7, R8, R13, or R14 follow those rules instead.

rules.title: Already compensated
rules.text: Already compensated. If the prior resolutions or the case record show a resolution already recorded for this same order_id, propose no_action with refund_amount 0, cite R13, and reference the existing resolution. Do not compensate the same order twice. R7 still applies to food safety complaints.

rules.title: Unsupported complaints
rules.text: Unsupported complaints. For complaints not covered by R1 to R8 (billing disputes, duplicate charges, promotions, product availability or substitutions, app or menu errors), use complaint_category other and propose escalate_to_manager with refund_amount 0 and requires_human_approval true. Do not invent a remedy. Cite R14.

closing: Unless a rule says otherwise, requires_human_approval is false.
